```artifact
Feature: Patient and Doctor Management

  As a patient or doctor, I want to manage my details and consultations within the system

  So that I can maintain accurate records and facilitate healthcare services

Scenario Outline: Editing Lab/Pharmacy Details
  Given I am an admin
  When I edit lab/pharmacy details
  Then I should be able to update or delete the details

  Given I am an admin
  When I attempt to edit non-existent lab/pharmacy details
  Then I should receive an error message

  Given I am an admin
  When I edit valid lab/pharmacy details
  Then I should see a confirmation of the update

Scenario Outline: Patient Registration
  Given I am a patient
  When I register
  Then I should be able to create my profile

  Given I am a patient
  When I attempt to register with invalid details
  Then I should receive an error message

  Given I am a patient
  When I register with valid details
  Then I should see a confirmation of my profile creation

Scenario Outline: Patient Profile Update
  Given I am a patient
  When I update my profile
  Then I should be able to modify my personal information

  Given I am a patient
  When I attempt to update my profile with invalid details
  Then I should receive an error message

  Given I am a patient
  When I update my profile with valid details
  Then I should see a confirmation of my profile update

Scenario Outline: Making Appointments and Online Consultation Requests
  Given I am a patient
  When I make an appointment or request an online consultation
  Then I should be able to submit my request

  Given I am a patient
  When I attempt to make an appointment with invalid details
  Then I should receive an error message

  Given I am a patient
  When I make an appointment with valid details
  Then I should see a confirmation of my appointment

Scenario Outline: Viewing and Generating Prescription Reports and Invoices
  Given I am a patient
  When I view and generate prescription reports and invoices
  Then I should be able to access my medical documents

  Given I am a patient
  When I attempt to view or generate reports with invalid details
  Then I should receive an error message

  Given I am a patient
  When I view or generate reports with valid details
  Then I should see a confirmation of my documents

Scenario Outline: Doctor Consultation
  Given I am a doctor
  When I provide a consultation
  Then I should be able to interact with the patient

  Given I am a doctor
  When I attempt to provide a consultation with invalid details
  Then I should receive an error message

  Given I am a doctor
  When I provide a consultation with valid details
  Then I should see a confirmation of my consultation

Scenario Outline: Prescribing Medicine
  Given I am a doctor
  When I prescribe medicine
  Then I should be able to assign medication to a patient

  Given I am a doctor
  When I attempt to prescribe medicine with invalid details
  Then I should receive an error message

  Given I am a doctor
  When I prescribe medicine with valid details
  Then I should see a confirmation of my prescription

Scenario Outline: Prescribing Lab Tests
  Given I am a doctor
  When I prescribe lab tests
  Then I should be able to assign lab tests to a patient

  Given I am a doctor
  When I attempt to prescribe lab tests with invalid details
  Then I should receive an error message

  Given I am a doctor
  When I prescribe lab tests with valid details
  Then I should see a confirmation of my prescription

```
